verdict.rationale: Factory's agent-readiness docs explicitly describe the exact scenario: "A designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs" (factory-docs-8), backed by delegation/review/merge workflow (factory-docs-1) and readiness tooling (factory-docs-9, factory-docs-10) that lets non-engineers trigger and validate implementation.
